hook.en: When a firm asks a bank for a loan, the bank manager first asks for its accounts. Many people outside and inside a business depend on these numbers.
hook.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಿಂದ ಸಾಲ ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ಮೊದಲು ಅದರ ಲೆಕ್ಕಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಒಳಗೂ ಹೊರಗೂ ಅನೇಕರು ಈ ಅಂಕಿಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

objectives.en: Explain accounting as an information system
Classify users into internal and external
State what each user needs from the accounts

narration.en: When a firm asks a bank for a loan, the bank manager first asks for its accounts. Many people outside and inside a business depend on these numbers.
narration.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಿಂದ ಸಾಲ ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ಮೊದಲು ಅದರ ಲೆಕ್ಕಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಒಳಗೂ ಹೊರಗೂ ಅನೇಕರು ಈ ಅಂಕಿಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

body.en: Accounting collects data on business transactions, processes it and produces reports such as the profit and loss account and the balance sheet. These reports tell users about the profitability and the financial position of the business, so accounting is called the language of business and an information system.
body.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಂತಹ ವರದಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದನ್ನು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಭಾಷೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.

points.en: Input: transactions; process: recording and classifying; output: financial reports
Reports show profit or loss and financial position

title.en: On the board: Who uses accounting information?

say.en: Accounting is an information system: transactions go in, reports come out.
Internal users work inside the business and use reports to plan and control.
External users are outside: each looks for a different answer.
Because everyone reads it, accounting is called the language of business.

prompt.en: Match each user of accounting information with what they most want to know.
prompt.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಪತ್ರ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರನ್ನು ಅವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಿಳಿಯಬಯಸುವ ವಿಷಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

right.en: Is the business earning a good profit on my capital?
Which department needs better control and planning?
Can the business repay the loan with interest on time?
Will our bills for goods supplied be paid?
Is this a safe business to invest in, and will it grow?
How much tax is due, and how is the industry doing?
Is my job secure, and can the firm pay a bonus?

explanation.en: Owners and investors look at profit and growth, management at control, lenders and creditors at repayment, the government at taxes, and employees at job security and bonus.

body.en: Internal users work inside the business: the chief executive, the finance, sales and production managers, and supervisors at every level. They use accounts for planning, control and decision making. External users are outside: banks and financial institutions, investors, creditors, tax authorities, regulatory agencies such as SEBI, consumers and researchers.
body.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು: ಆಡಳಿತ ವರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು. ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರು: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕುಗಳು, ಹೂಡಿಕೆದಾರರು, ಸಾಲಿಗರು, ತೆರಿಗೆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳು, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು.

points.en: Investors: is the investment safe and profitable?
Creditors: will we be paid on time?
Government: how much tax is due?

They use accounts for planning, control and decision making. External users are outside: banks and financial institutions, investors, creditors, tax authorities, regulatory agencies such as SEBI, consumers and researchers.

problem.en: Match each user of Sri Lakshmi Textiles with what it looks for: (a) Canara Bank, (b) a supplier of yarn on credit, (c) the GST department, (d) the sales manager.

steps.en: (a) Canara Bank checks whether the firm can repay the loan with interest.
(b) The yarn supplier checks whether the firm pays its creditors on time.
(c) The GST department checks turnover to assess the tax due.
(d) The sales manager compares sales by month and region to plan targets.

answer.en: (a) repaying capacity, (b) short-term solvency, (c) tax due, (d) sales planning

points.en: Accounting is an information system and the language of business.

points.en: Internal users are the managers who run the business.
External users include banks, investors, creditors, government and regulators.

homework.en: List four external users and the information each needs.

narration.en: Recap. Accounting is an information system and the language of business. Internal users are the managers who run the business. External users include banks, investors, creditors, government and regulators.
